description: The shapes the frame-vector execution path has to get right, over a fixture carrying NULLs in both partitions. The engine's window evaluator is DUAL-PATH: with execution.window.frameVectors on (the default) an argument is evaluated once per partition row into a vector, and with it off each frame row is evaluated separately - and a safety gate keeps a non-vector-safe argument such as a function call on the row path even when the flag is on, while a cast and an arithmetic expression are vector-safe shapes. The flag is an ENGINE CONSTRUCTION property with no SQL surface, so query/WindowFrameVectorsFlagTest - which builds two engines and compares them - stays as Java and is recorded as a deferral. This suite is its companion on the DEFAULT path: it pins the actual ANSWERS for the same shapes, which the Java never did (it only asserted the two paths AGREE, something they could do while both being wrong). Running aggregates, explicit frames, the value functions, the conditional-event counters and both sides of the vector-safety gate are all here. One reading is recorded rather than endorsed: with an ORDER BY and no explicit frame, LAST_VALUE answers the whole partition's last value for every row where Snowflake's default RANGE frame would end at the current row's last peer - pinned as the engine's CURRENT behaviour so a change is visible, not as a live-verified claim.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER, grp VARCHAR, x INTEGER)
SELECT id, SUM(x) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS v FROM t ORDER BY id
SELECT id, AVG(x) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY id)::VARCHAR AS v FROM t ORDER BY id
SELECT id, COUNT(x) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS v FROM t ORDER BY id
SELECT id, MIN(x) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS mn, MAX(x) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS mx FROM t ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER, grp VARCHAR, x INTEGER)
SELECT id, SUM(x) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS v FROM t ORDER BY id
SELECT id, SUM(x) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS v FROM t ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER, grp VARCHAR, x INTEGER)
SELECT id, FIRST_VALUE(x) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY id) AS f, LAST_VALUE(x) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY id) AS l, NTH_VALUE(x, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY id) AS n FROM t ORDER BY id
SELECT id, RATIO_TO_REPORT(x) OVER (PARTITION BY grp)::VARCHAR AS v FROM t ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER, grp VARCHAR, x INTEGER)
SELECT id, CONDITIONAL_TRUE_EVENT(x > 10) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS a, CONDITIONAL_CHANGE_EVENT(x) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY id) AS b FROM t ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER, grp VARCHAR, x INTEGER)
SELECT id, MIN(UPPER(grp)) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS v FROM t ORDER BY id
SELECT id, SUM(x::NUMBER + 1) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS v FROM t ORDER BY id
